purpose: Optional implementation schema; source specimen values remain in commerce blueprint
invariants: Use integer minor units; do not mix currencies in one total.
Resolve price and availability from selected variant, not stale card copy.
Quantity must be a positive integer; preserve selection while changing gallery image.
Do not infer live availability from a serialized availableForSale snapshot.
Keep inventory, tax, shipping, payment and delivery server responsibilities when a real authorized backend is supplied.
recommendations: Expose visible labels, disabled states and keyboard focus.
Announce cart count and errors accessibly; avoid repeated announcements.
Do not add visible controls or sections absent from the reference merely to implement this schema.
verification: Source and artwork inspected; shopping controls, persisted carts, checkout, inventory, payment, download delivery and licenses untested.
